title: flemingia strobilifera var. bracteata
intro: Flemingia strobilifera var. bracteata, commonly known as Chinese snake root or snake root, is a plant species traditionally used in Chinese medicine. It has been used for its various health benefits, including reducing fever, treating respiratory infections, and alleviating rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Flemingia strobilifera var. bracteata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
